== Star credential ==

'''Asha Bhose''' is the centre of this demonstration star credential.

This page is deliberately a scaffold: it records the credential structure without inventing endpoint identifiers that have not yet been established.

{| class="wikitable"
! Role !! Resource
|-
| A — centre || Asha Bhose
|-
| B || ''Endpoint to be established''
|}

=== Machine form ===
<pre>
[Asha Bhose]
[endpoint-to-be-established]
</pre>

The centre is distinguished by convention; the B resources are an unordered set. Supporting endpoint evidence should be added before this credential is treated as a substantive same-entity assertion.

See [[VillageLink:Star credential]].
